issue: राधे धन न्यौछावर कीजै: राधे read as an invocation (Rādhe!); the Budhwar recension has तन मन (धन) न्यौछावर.
our reading: Rādhe! Offer up your wealth for them.

issue: आधा नील पीत पटसारी: the pair's one form, half in Rādhā's blue sari, half in Kṛṣṇa's yellow robe; the Budhwar recension has ओढ़े नील पीत पट सारी.
our reading: half is clad in a blue sari, half in a yellow robe
alternatives: wearing blue and yellow garments; पट सारी 'all the garments'

issue: परमानन्द स्वामी अविचल जोरी: the poet's signature (Paramānandadāsa). Read like कृष्णदास-प्रभु in yashoda-lala-aarti, 'the lords of Paramānanda', which supplies no verb; not confirmed in an independent source.
our reading: the lords of Paramānanda, are an unshakeable pair
alternatives: an unshakeable pair, says Paramānanda Svāmī (a verb supplied)
